headlines.title: Stock futures fall as 10-year Treasury yield tops 5%
headlines.summary: The 10-year yield cracking 5% — its highest since 2007 — is not a footnote, it is a REGIME CHANGE. Every equity valuation model on the planet uses that number as its discount rate, which means the consensus 'soft landing' story just got a lot harder to sell. With a Fed hike priced at 94% probability and oil simultaneously squeezing margins, the one-two punch hits everything from rate-sensitive REITs and utilities to leveraged tech multiples — there is NOWHERE to hide in the standard 60/40 playbook.

headlines.title: Saudi says Houthis targeted Mecca with a drone, Iran-backed group rejects claim
headlines.summary: A drone aimed at MECCA — Islam's holiest site — is not a routine escalation, it is the kind of event that rewrites geopolitical risk premiums overnight. Strait of Hormuz crossings already in single digits, Saudi pipeline offline, and now a strike on a target that could pull the entire Gulf Cooperation Council into a wider confrontation — the oil supply disruption thesis just found a new, uglier chapter. Energy names catch a bid while airlines, consumer discretionary, and anything dependent on Middle East logistics gets quietly repriced by people who are NOT telling you about it on television.

headlines.title: Intel, SK Hynix shares jump on report they're discussing U.S. memory chip manufacturing
headlines.summary: Intel desperately needs a marquee foundry customer and SK Hynix desperately needs U.S. soil to stay on the right side of export controls — so this partnership, if real, is MUTUALLY ASSURED RELEVANCE for two companies the market had largely written off as yesterday's news. The ripple hits the entire semiconductor supply chain: it validates domestic chip manufacturing subsidies, pressures TSMC's U.S. ambitions, and puts a floor under Intel's battered foundry narrative at exactly the moment the Philly Semi Index just posted its worst day in two months.
